name: Western Australia – China spodumene
notes: Spodumene concentrate from Greenbushes, loaded at Bunbury (drawn): the principal load port rests on the mine's technical report (RPM Global for Albemarle, SEC filing, FY2025: the concentrate is trucked to the Port of Bunbury for export); the Argus report of Australia's lithium loadings, in which Bunbury was the largest of the three ports, covers one month only (September 2025) and gives no annual share. Also from the Pilbara mines (Port Hedland) and from Mount Marion (Esperance), as in the lanes; the lanes discharge at Qingdao, the route at Lianyungang and Zhangjiagang. The corridor volume is an Atlas estimate: spodumene has no customs code of its own and is read from HS 253090 (mineral substances not elsewhere specified), Australia to China (see the lithium page).
